_how: Fill with the user before storyboarding. Every claim must be checkable (README, config, the user's own words). Keep feature lines short — they become narration and on-screen labels.
audience: clinicians and medical researchers who are not full-time statisticians

pain.zh: 一项研究，太多软件：清洗、统计、作图、排版各自为战。
pain.en: One study, too many tools — cleaning, statistics, figures and formatting all live in different places.

features.zh: 导入即识别：变量类型、缺失、取值范围
features.en: Import, and it's understood: types, missingness, ranges

features.zh: 数据工具箱：计算、重编码、批量、医学标准、合并
features.en: A data toolbox: compute, recode, batch, standards, merge

features.zh: 三线表、图表与 AI 解读一次生成
features.en: Tables, figures and AI interpretation together

features.zh: 不发送原始数据行；可接本机模型
features.en: Never sends raw rows; local models supported

features.zh: 期刊级图表、Word 报告、可复现 R 脚本
features.en: Journal figures, Word reports, reproducible R

differentiators: 清洗、统计、作图、排版分散在多个软件
一个工作台，从数据到论文
结果需手工整理成三线表
APA 三线表与期刊级图表自动生成
Word 报告 + 可复现 R 脚本

zh: 把繁琐交给 AI，把时间还给研究者——
去想清楚一个真正的科学问题。
motto.en: Hand the tedium to AI. Give researchers their time back — to think through the questions that truly matter.

target_duration_s: follow the music (extend a chorus if the story needs more time)
